# xelon_device_backup (Resource)

The device backup resource manages the assignment of one cloud-wide backup plan to a Xelon device.

Deleting this resource disables backups for the device by removing its backup plan assignment. It does not delete the device or the backup plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xelon_device_backup" "example" {
  device_id      = xelon_device.example.id
  backup_plan_id = 17
}
```

## Lifecycle

Resource existence means the device has a backup plan assigned. Changing `backup_plan_id` updates the assignment in place.
Destroying the resource disables backups for the device by changing its assignment to none; it does not delete the device or backup plan.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_plan_id` (Number) ID of the backup plan assigned to the device.
- `device_id` (String) ID of the device whose backup plan assignment is managed. Changing this value requires replacing the resource.

## Import

Using `terraform import`, import a device backup assignment with the device ID. The assigned backup plan is discovered during refresh. For example:

```shell
terraform import xelon_device_backup.example <device-id>
```
